messages:
Omar (PM): Quick flag from support: users click the console 'Help hub' expecting the exact control docs but land at the docs root. Friction.

Ravi (Design): I noticed this too. Sidecar links are generic. Deep-linking to anchors would be ideal, but we need stable ids.

Leah (Docs): Current headings change during copy updates which breaks fragment links. I can add explicit IDs like `### Dedicated Capacity {#dedicated-capacity}` to the markdown.

Ivy (Support): That would help a lot. Our KB curators also want a canonical link format to paste into replies.

Sam (DevEx): Implementation plan: 1) Docs team adds stable kebab-case IDs, 2) Console links use `https://docs.redwood.inference/console/<page>#<anchor>`, 3) add redirect aliases for renamed anchors.

Ravi (Design): UX nit: when jumping to an anchor, offset the scroll so the heading isn't hidden by the sticky header. Also focus the heading (tabindex="-1" + focus()) for screen readers.

Leah (Docs): Agreed on kebab-case. I'll publish a short guide for authors and add CI warnings when a linked heading lacks an explicit ID.

Omar (PM): Can we add a tiny docs preview in the sidecar instead of opening a new tab? Maybe an excerpt API? Sam?

Sam (DevEx): We can add `/api/docs/preview?page=...&anchor=...` returning title+excerpt. Cache for a day. If not found, fallback to opening docs home and show toast: "Section moved 14 opening Docs home".

Ivy (Support): Please add the canonical link examples to the KB draft. I'll maintain a quick lookup table.

Ravi (Design): I'll prototype the offset + small preview tooltip tomorrow. Microcopy for the preview: "Open docs for this control (new tab)".

Leah (Docs): I'll start adding IDs to the most-linked pages this week and include the canonical link examples in PRs.

Omar (PM): Owners: Leah (stable-anchors), Sam (preview-api), Ravi (UI offset + microcopy), Ivy (KB). I'll add QA steps for 3 deep links mobile+desktop. Thanks all.
